goals.title: Bright protected garden
goals.requirement: At bed, an actual rootbed is enclosed, illuminated and receiving clean water in the day row. Any construction satisfying those properties works.

goals.title: First signal
goals.requirement: The northern receiver has actually received the camp location through an optical event, and the bed garden is currently functioning. Both goals may complete together.

goals.title: Still and growing place
goals.requirement: At bed, an actual enclosed illuminated rootbed receives clean water originating at one of this map’s real source places. Keep a dry walk from walk-start to walk-end. The clean source is a legal alternative to purification.

goals.title: Drying and preservation
goals.requirement: A support carrying bright-specimen at table is dry, illuminated and air-exposed; a different support carrying dark-specimen at alcove is dark and protected. The actual records/site tags remain separate.

goals.title: Two skies
goals.requirement: One actual rootbed at bed is enclosed, clean-water-fed and illuminated in both opposing sky rows. Static dual sources, actual reflected light or any other legal assembly may work; no controller is prescribed.

goals.title: Two viewpoints
goals.requirement: The protected alcove contains actual records of spire observed from west-view and east-view. A single camera moved between views is valid. Copies of an unobserving camera do not acquire either record.

goals.title: Carry the existing garden
goals.requirement: The actual initial garden object from start reaches destination with its living rootbed identity retained and its enclosure, illumination and clean-water supply functioning. A fresh copy at destination is not movement of that garden.

goals.title: Deploy then recover
goals.requirement: A mobile assembly has actually supplied a span across gap-west–gap-east and traveled through the low arch, and now stands at gap-east or destination while a real usable gap crossing remains. Leaving another physical span copy is legal; an absent span cannot support the gap.

goals.title: Warm place, protected sample
goals.requirement: At warm-room, an actual tray or recording support is enclosed, protected and warmed; a distinct sample support at sample-alcove is dark and protected, and an enclosed illuminated clean-water-fed rootbed grows at bed in every listed row.

goals.title: Usable window
goals.requirement: Actual tray or recording supports inside enclosures at warm-room and cool-room are protected in both dust rows; an actual instrument retained at window has recorded the visible valley-marker in a clear row; a distinct dark, dust-protected sample support at sample-alcove has actually acquired valley-sample from specimen-site.

goals.title: Distinguishable messages
goals.requirement: Receiver actually obtains the A-original and B-original records, while their original recording objects remain protected at original-a and original-b respectively. Keep a traversable return route from junction to dock. Fresh design copies do not carry historical records.

goals.title: Recover the stranded instrument
goals.requirement: The actual initial stranded-camera, retaining its expedition record and identity, reaches dock and delivers that record to the receiver. Both original source objects remain protected at their own places. Modifying the camera into a vehicle is legal.
